byte_protocol.canonical_json: existing strict UTF8 canonical JSON, duplicate/nonfinite/float numeric values rejected for these documents
byte_protocol.receipt_hash: SHA256(UTF8(receipt domain) || NUL || canonical receipt body); no nested timing omission
byte_protocol.reasons_hash: SHA256(UTF8(reasons domain) || NUL || canonical ordered deduplicated reason array)
byte_protocol.receipt_id: PCECLOSE- plus uppercase first 32 hex characters of SHA256(UTF8(receipt_id domain) || NUL || canonical {campaign_id, authorization_grant_sha256, authorization_consumption_entry_sha256})
byte_protocol.signature_message: UTF8(signature domain) || NUL || ASCII(document_type) || NUL || ASCII(role) || NUL || ASCII(key_id) || NUL || raw32(signed_sha256)
byte_protocol.ledger_entry_hash: SHA256(UTF8(ledger_entry domain) || NUL || ASCII(ledger_id) || NUL || uint64be(sequence) || raw32(previous_head_sha256) || canonical entry body)

partial_rules: The complete seven-file manifest/publication format is unchanged and validated through its pinned profile.
A normal partial directory must contain an exact initial prefix of artifact_write_order, with no gaps, extra files or sidecars; the last attempted file may be empty or partial.

timed_last_completed_write_stage is an external postrun attestation, not inferred from file existence. Present prefix length must equal its completed-stage index or that index plus one, capped at seven.

Map the new completed write stage and file-specific artifact error into the v2 facts/receipt using core_stage_and_error_projection; do not describe a timing-plan write failure as a manifest write failure.
manifestless_failure means no completed usable manifest, not that no partial manifest path can exist. A completed manifest with missing/invalid publication is manifest_present_invalid.
A normal complete bundle requires all seven files and independent structural/hash/timing verification. Partial or invalid bundles never authorize closure.
Require private/public privacy and fresh-database/normative-mutation attestations before normal artifact inspection; scan actual bytes before parsing or publishing any hash.
Only safely inspected normal-prefix bytes may populate partial_artifacts; no unavailable file, inferred zero count or unverified total may be invented.
Zero bytes are allowed only for the final attempted-but-not-completed file; a file attested as completed must have positive size.
layer_a_rules: Verify exact v3 signed pre-execution graph and its separate v1 pre-execution observations; derive its as-of from the independently supplied consumed-anchor observation.
Require postrun/final v2 observation history to match the verified pre-execution observations canonically; wrapper version/mode differences are explicit, never a re-signed document downgrade.
Derive candidate/source/runner/registry/model/budget/case/run and manifest expectations from signed documents and out-of-band observations, never from archive claims.
For normal evidence verify v4 historical source, v5 first-live protocol/artifact/review, complete first-live/campaign src/lock/pyproject equivalence, and registry admission before eligibility.
Verify every actual audit chain using the original v1.2 bytes and hashes. Explicitly accept only the fixed timing extension; do not rewrite events to v1.1 or repair their hashes.
Recompute all inherited record/denominator/SDK usage/index/send/tool/input-commitment/budget/UTC chronology predicates on these same verified rows.

Validate all timing segments, record/usage references, clock domains, complete denominators, monotonic request/phase/cleanup bounds, no overlap and publication linkage using the pinned timing contract.
The contract's timing conditions are additional conjuncts, not a replacement for inherited safety/usage/budget/private-canary conditions.
evidence_valid denotes structural/semantic validity, not eligibility; valid incomplete evidence yields false eligibility and reasons.
Do not sign, mint runtime bindings/claims, read real Keys, perform Provider/network calls, rescore or backfill historical data.
layer_b_rules: Validate the new receipt's schema, ID, body/reasons hashes, exact task_custodian signature and temporal/role validity.
Validate the v2 final closure_evidence_anchored entry using the new entry/head/signature domains; its sequence/previous head continue the verified v1 consumption chain exactly.
The final entry binds the entire new receipt hash; compare every independently supplied receipt and final-anchor observation plus all existing chronology constraints.
For normal evidence invoke the exact timed layer A once on raw inputs; require byte-equal unsigned receipt projection including every timing field before any true closure flag.
No boolean, validated-looking summary, self-reported source identity, legacy receipt or caller callback can replace recomputation.
quarantine_rules: For sensitive_quarantined or privacy_unverified_quarantined, inspect no artifact directory, timing evidence/publication file or private postrun data; layer B does not call layer A.
Validate only the signed public failure receipt, v3 pre-history and final witness/observations; a failure attestation is not execution or valid artifact evidence.
All artifact hashes and partial_artifacts are null/empty as specified; timing.status is quarantined, gate false, file hashes/clock domain/duration null.
Never promote quarantine to evidence_valid or closure true, even when signatures and witness are valid.

timing_status_rules.verified: same-row timing and all numeric/coverage/publication constraints complete; error null, reasons empty, both file hashes/domain/duration present
timing_status_rules.incomplete: well-formed linked evidence has missing/unsuccessful observations; error null, nonempty fixed incomplete reasons, gate false
timing_status_rules.invalid: structural/hash/binding/order/duration violation; fixed error non-null, evidence_valid false, gate false; no unvalidated phase duration
timing_status_rules.unavailable: no safely available timing evidence; gate false and artifact timing observations null, not zero
timing_status_rules.quarantined: policy prohibits artifact inspection; not a claim that files do not exist

error_precedence: existing privacy/origin/source/structure/chain/projection/budget checks before timing checks; primary rejection order is not causal attribution
eligibility_rule: normal complete bundle AND all inherited recomputed closure predicates AND verified v4/v5 admission AND timing.status=verified AND timing.gate_complete=true AND empty ordered reasons; true closure is returned only after valid final witness and layer-B recomputation
failure_gate_rule: any unknown/missing/unmapped completion state, fallback source, empty case, pending/unknown attempt, privacy failure, drift, budget violation or missing/invalid/overlapping timing forbids closure
reason_derivation: When evidence_valid=false preserve the predecessor's empty reason array and null derived counters, but commit the empty array with the new v2 reasons domain. Fixed evidence_error_code and timing.status/error_code carry invalid/unavailable/quarantine diagnosis. Only valid evidence combines inherited reasons with timing incomplete/publication reasons.
